definitions.explanation: An interest rate expressed on a per-year basis. The standard unit for advertising loan and deposit rates in Japan.

examples.japanese: {年利|ねんり}1⟦パーセント→パーセント：01537_paasento⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{借|か}りた→借りる：00532_kariru⟧。
examples.english: I borrowed at one percent annual interest.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{定期預金|ていきよきん}→定期預金：22251_teikiyokin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{年利|ねんり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: This fixed-term deposit has a high annual interest rate.

examples.japanese: ⟦カード→カード：03836_kaado⟧⟦ローン→ローン：06579_roon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{年利|ねんり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{気|き}をつけた→気をつける：09771_kiwotsukeru⟧⟦ほうがいい→ほうがいい：10078_hougaii⟧。
examples.english: Card loans have high annual interest, so you should be careful.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧ (year) + ⟦{利|り}→利：29142_ri⟧ (interest; profit). The default time unit for quoting interest rates in everyday Japanese finance.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {年利|ねんり}⟦{換算|かんさん}→換算：07992_kansan⟧: annualized rate
- {年利|ねんり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧ / ⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧: high / low annual interest
- {年利|ねんり}⟦{固定|こてい}→固定：10996_kotei⟧: fixed annual rate
- ⟦{実質|じっしつ}→実質：12282_jisshitsu⟧{年利|ねんり}: real (after-fee) annual interest rate

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {月利|げつり}: monthly interest rate — used mainly for short-term consumer credit
- ⟦{利率|りりつ}→利率：21159_riritsu⟧: interest rate (general term, time unit unspecified)
- ⟦{金利|きんり}→金利：04856_kinri⟧: interest rate; finance charge — broader, often used for loans and deposits without specifying the period
